title: Leaving Zurich
content:
The trip's first leg, and the only one that leaves the ground. Written to show
what a flight looks like on the map: a long dashed arc between two continents,
against the solid train line and the dotted boat further east.

Nobody took this day. It exists so the map has an aeroplane on it.
